sentences.text: The evidence does not show any rule here that specifically governs a Tier 3 UCB opening a new branch in another state without RBI’s prior approval.

The only branch-related text in the evidence says a UCB may continue a temporary premise beyond 30 days with specific approval from the respective Regional Office of RBI, and may set up satellite offices, extension counters, or mobile banking facilities under intimation to Reserve Bank.
The evidence also shows that the Responsible Business Conduct Directions apply to all UCBs, and that the bank is a Tier 3 UCB.

missing: whether RBI has a specific prior-approval requirement for opening a new branch in another state; searched the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions provisions on branch/premise-related openings and the Tier 3 UCB applicability text, but no explicit rule on this question was found.

missing.slot: specific rule on opening a new branch in another state and whether prior RBI approval is required
missing.searched: UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions provisions on premises, satellite offices, extension counters, mobile banking facilities, and applicability to UCBs/Tier 3 UCBs
